title: SigmaHQ Regression Test info.yml
description: Specification for regression test metadata files used by the SigmaHQ regression test runner.

id.description: A unique UUID for this regression test entry. Different from the rule ID.

description.description: Free-text description of what the test verifies. Use "N/A" if no description is available.

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the regression test was created or last updated.

author.description: Full name of the author, optionally followed by organization in parentheses.

rule_metadata.description: Metadata linking this regression test to the Sigma rule it validates.

id.description: The Sigma rule UUID. Must exactly match the id field in the corresponding .yml rule file.

title.description: The Sigma rule title. Should match the title field in the corresponding .yml rule file.

regression_tests_info.description: List of regression test entries. Currently only Positive Detection Test type is supported.

name.description: Human-readable test name. Currently only "Positive Detection Test" is supported.

type.description: Test type. "evtx" runs the sample through evtx-sigma-checker; "json" is a single JSON object; "ndjson"/"jsonl" are newline-delimited JSON objects converted via sigma convert and run by json_checker.

provider.description: Windows event provider used by the evtx-sigma-checker. All existing tests include it, but the runner does not enforce its presence.

match_count.description: Minimum number of matches required. If omitted, the runner requires at least one match. If actual count exceeds this value, a warning is emitted rather than a failure.

pipelines.description: Sigma pipelines applied before conversion. JSON types only; when omitted, the rule is converted with --without-pipeline.

filters.description: Sigma filters applied during conversion. JSON types only.

path.description: Relative path from the repository root to the test sample file.
